name: Slack
description: Read channels and threads the bot is a member of, look up people, post messages and add reactions. Reads are automatic; every post and reaction asks you first.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List the public and private channels the bot is a member of

tools.name: get_channel_history
tools.description: Read recent messages of a channel (up to 50)

tools.name: lookup_user
tools.description: Look up a user's name and real name (no email)

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a channel or thread (asks you)

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message (asks you)

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bot user OAuth token (xoxb-…) of your Slack app

secrets.name: SLACK_APP_TOKEN
secrets.description: App-level token (xapp-…) for Orbit's Slack trigger over Socket Mode; only orbitd uses it, the plugin never gets it

settings.name: SLACK_DEFAULT_CHANNEL
settings.description: Channel id (C…) post_message uses when the Bot names none. Optional.
